## Scrolly comments
Instagram comment with a keyword → freebie DM (automatic).
Every Instagram, YouTube and TikTok comment → sorted by free word rules → the comment inbox (hooks.scrollyseo.com/inbox) as Needs draft.
Claude (subscription) writes the drafts; approve in the dashboard → posted right away or within 10 minutes (TikTok: reply by hand).
Optional: CLAUDE_API_DRAFTS=true drafts with the paid Claude API instead.

Test mode is on until COMMENTS_DRY_RUN=false.
Code lives in automation/n8n-comments/workflow/src (edit there, rebuild, re-import).
